title: Learning to Play: Reinforcement Learning and Games
abstract: arXiv:2610.17391v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Amazing breakthroughs in reinforcement learning have taken place. Computers teach themselves to play Chess and Go and beat world champions. There is talk about expanding application areas towards general artificial intelligence (AI). The breakthroughs in Backgammon, Checkers, Chess, Atari, Go, Poker, and StarCraft have shown that we can build machines that exhibit intelligent game playing of the highest level. These successes have been widely publicized in the media, and inspire AI entrepreneurs and scientists alike. Reinforcement learning in games has become a mainstream AI research topic. It is a broad topic, and the successes build on a range of diverse techniques, from exact planning algorithms, to adaptive sampling, deep function approximation, and ingenious self-play methods. Perhaps because of the breadth of these technologies, or because of the recency of the breakthroughs, there are few books that explain these methods in depth.

translated_title: 学会对弈：强化学习与游戏
translated_abstract: 强化学习领域已经取得了惊人的突破。计算机能够自学国际象棋和围棋，并击败世界冠军。人们正在讨论将这些应用领域拓展至通用人工智能（AI）。在西洋双陆棋、跳棋、国际象棋、雅达利游戏、围棋、扑克和星际争霸等游戏中取得的突破表明，我们能够构建展现出最高水平智能博弈能力的机器。这些成功在媒体上被广泛报道，同时激励着AI企业家和科学家。游戏中的强化学习已成为主流的AI研究课题。这是一个宽泛的主题，其成功建立在一系列多样化技术的基础之上，包括精确规划算法、自适应采样、深度函数逼近以及巧妙的自博弈方法。或许是由于这些技术的广度，或是由于这些突破出现的时间尚短，目前很少有书籍能够深入阐释这些方法。
tldr: 本文系统介绍了强化学习在西洋双陆棋、国际象棋、围棋、星际争霸等游戏中取得突破性成功的历程，并涵盖精确规划、自适应采样、深度函数逼近和自博弈等关键技术的深入讲解。
en_tdlr: This work provides an in-depth explanation of the breakthrough successes of reinforcement learning in games such as Backgammon, Chess, Go, and StarCraft, covering key techniques ranging from exact planning and adaptive sampling to deep function approximation and self-play.
